### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | 適用 ACM 全站《Policy on Authorship》(TSC 投稿指南頁面明確指向此政策,未見 TSC 專屬加嚴版本)。生成式 AI 工具不得列為作者;允許用其產生內容(文字/表格/圖/程式碼/資料/引文等),但須在 Acknowledgements 揭露,揭露程度須與 AI 產生內容比例相稱;不確定是否需揭露時,ACM 建議從寬揭露。ACM 保留因誠信問題退稿或事後撤稿之權利。此外 ACM 另有獨立的 Peer Review Policy,明訂審稿人不得將投稿內容上傳至 ChatGPT/Gemini 等第三方 LLM 工具,以避免違反保密與作者匿名。 |
| **Source URL** | https://www.acm.org/publications/policies/new-acm-policy-on-authorship |

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** 期刊定位為「運算系統與社會科學交會」的跨學科刊物,涵蓋系統開發與評估、實證研究、系統性文獻回顧、理論建構、案例研究、研究轉譯實踐等多種文類。目前有進行中的徵稿專題 'Bridging AI and Social Science: Human–Algorithm Interaction at Scale'(2026年1月見於 INFORMS Open Forum 轉發),顯示近期選題偏向 AI 與社會科學交界的人機互動研究。因 dl.acm.org 期刊首頁被擋(403),未能直接核對 2024-2026 實際刊出文章標題清單,positioning 屬 scope+CFP 層級證據,非逐篇文章驗證。

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** theoretical, algorithmic, empirical/quantitative, experimental, qualitative, ethnographic, design research, engineering/systems development & evaluation, case study, systematic literature review

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **experiential.review_time_months**: No SciRev entries exist for this journal (page 404s / zero submissions logged); no forum thread on muchong, zhihu, or Reddit reports an actual observed turnaround. The only number found — a 6-week reviewer-return deadline in ACM's invitation template — is an instruction to reviewers, not a first-hand outcome, so it was excluded per HARD RULES.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No public source (SciRev, forums, editor statements) reports a desk-reject rate for this specific journal.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: No first-hand author account found describing what got accepted vs rejected.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No concrete forum post or first-hand account describing reviewer behavior/culture for this journal specifically was found in this search pass.
- **preprint.allowed**: No TSC-specific preprint clause was located; only ACM's general author-rights policy is inferred, so this is a low-confidence placeholder rather than a verified journal-level fact.
- **peer_review.type**: ACM's general Peer Review Policy page was found, but a TSC-specific statement of single- vs double-anonymous review was not directly confirmed (dl.acm.org/journal/tsc/review-guidelines returned only boilerplate reviewer timing, and the main journal page 403'd).
- **positioning.accepts_now (article-level verification)**: dl.acm.org/journal/tsc returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, so no individual 2024-2026 article titles could be pulled and checked one by one; positioning is based on aims/scope text and one special-issue CFP found via search snippets only.
